title: 'from __future__' error running on python3.8rc1
body:
# Summary

 I have installed streamlit using pip for python3.8rc1.

Upon running `streamlit hello` and visiting the localhost URL, I see the following in a web popup:

```
File "/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.8/lib/python3.8/site-packages/streamlit/hello.py", line 18
  from __future__ import division, unicode_literals
  ^
SyntaxError: from __future__ imports must occur at the beginning of the file
```

Briefly looking at the source for this file, I do not understand what is causing the error.


# Steps to reproduce

What are the steps we should take to reproduce the bug:
1. Install python3.8rc1 on macOS catalina.
2. `pip3 install streamlit`. Will require Developer Tools and fussing with pillow Zlib dependency.
3. Run `streamlit hello`.
4. Visit the page.


# Debug info

- Streamlit version: 0.47.4
- Python version: Python 3.8.0rc1
- Using Conda? PipEnv? PyEnv? Pex? No.
- OS version: macOS 10.15 Beta (19A582a)
- Browser version: Safari Version 13.0.2 (15608.2.30.1.1)

comments.body:
Python 3.8 doesn't work very well for me, but you can get it running by just removing the line above, like so: https://github.com/XBattleFan/streamlit/commit/6422cb07e66434f51d86540c5f083ca555532695

Fractals and plotting will work, none of the others.
We have full python 3.8 support now, and we've dropped python 2 support.
